teaser: From Lovable to your own newsroom: a brief for José Bota and his agent, every app on GitHub Pages under his own domain, each an article.
core_idea: José Bota's Lovable tools that measure an agent's reach need a home: a brief his agent can follow moves each MVP to a GitHub repository published with Pages, puts it under a domain with his name bought in Route 53 with one subdomain per app, and adds a newsroom on the same domain using this newsroom's workflow, so every app becomes an article; success is two or three links; the business is helping companies see and protect their agents' reach, with public demos and private client repositories through the same workflow.
